faqs.a:
(a)
Penalty.
A violation of this article shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment not to exceed
               the limits established in
section 1-5
of this Code.
(b)
Continuing violation.
In accordance with
section 1-5
of this Code, every day any violation of this article continues or is permitted or
               allowed to continue shall constitute a separate offense.
(c)
Concurrent remedies.
The initiation of a prosecution for a violation of this article shall not preclude
               any other remedies available to the city under this Code.
(
Ord. No. 4887
, § 1, 1-27-2025)
